Get Object Store files of a specific organization and key. The /object/get API accepts requests in the following format:

GetObjectStoreJobIdRequest Model - Request to create a download job for some Object Store files.
organizationId string
required
example: 5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691
Id of the organization that owns the Object Store.
keys string Array
required
example: ['key1', 'key2']
Keys of the Object Store files.
Example 
{
  "organizationId": "5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691",
  "keys": [
    "key1",
    "key2"
  ]
}
GetObjectStoreURLRequest Model - Request to get a download URL for some Object Store files.
organizationId string
required
example: 5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691
Id of the organization that owns the Object Store.
jobId string
required
example: 2585354eb2e23cbbc4ba714332884650
Id of the download job for the files.
Example 
{
  "organizationId": "5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691",
  "jobId": "2585354eb2e23cbbc4ba714332884650"
}
